reasoning: Both audits confirm PKGBUILD uses pinned sources with integrity checks, contains no dangerous build/install logic, and desktop file is standard. No evidence of malicious behavior.
coverage_issues: Neither model reviewed package.json or build scripts (e.g., build:linux in package.json) executed during pnpm build
Source files with network/filesystem access (e.g., main/renderer processes) were not prioritized
false_positives: deepseek flagged e2e tests as SAFE (correct) but wasted resources reviewing them despite explicit deprioritization rules
false_negatives: Potential risk in build scripts (pnpm run build:linux) not reviewed - could execute arbitrary code during build
learnings: Improve file prioritization: Build scripts > source with I/O > install hooks > tests
Enforce rules: Skip test files unless PKGBUILD check() references them
Add build-script awareness: Detect npm/pnpm/scripts executed during makepkg
